Rules:
- Propose at most 3 things, the most valuable first. Cite the ids of the facts each one relies on.

proposal.summary: The audience reaches 18,703 lines on SMS, and data bundle upsell campaigns have a positive lift (+0.93 points) against their holdout, though no segment is clearly different from the rest. Recent contact is moderate (14% got a campaign in 7 days) and only 49 lines are at the 3-campaign cap.

proposals.title: Consider top-up reminder instead of data upsell
proposals.rationale: Top-up reminder campaigns show a higher past lift (+1.63) than data upsell (+0.93), but the goal is to upsell a bigger data bundle, so this only fits if the goal can be reframed; the campaign manager should decide.

proposals.title: Keep the audience as it is
proposals.rationale: No segment is clearly different from the rest for data upsell, so narrowing or excluding segments is not supported. About 14% of lines were contacted in the last 7 days and only 49 lines are at the 30-day cap, so contact pressure is a point to watch but not a reason to change the audience. SMS reaches 18,703 lines and email would reach 14,264, so there is no evidence that switching channel helps.
